properties.name: Marine protected area pilot (with the Ocean Climate Fund)
properties.summary: MPAs range from strict no-take reserves to paper parks. Outcomes depend on how the MPA is structured, not on how much the area is used, as Sharm el-Sheikh and Cancún show.
properties.boundary_notes: Pilot site to be chosen (Azores or Bermuda). Boundary from the Ocean Climate Fund's Gaia layers. Indicative: the Azores, one of two candidate pilot sites (the other is Bermuda).

properties.name: Renewable energy citizen share
properties.summary: Operating solar and wind assets earn high margins because the fuel is free and staffing is light. A codified share of revenue could fund a citizen right to energy instead of discretionary community benefits.
properties.boundary_notes: Pilot portfolio to be chosen (Iberia discussed). Indicative: the Iberian Peninsula, where the pilot portfolio was discussed.
